caption: The drawing features a patchwork quilt design on a cream-colored background. In the upper left quadrant, a large, eight-pointed star composed of diamond shapes uses alternating strips of red, green, pink, and cream, each filled with small dot or floral patterns. Adjacent to this, a large section of the quilt displays rows of diamonds in green, red, teal, and pink, forming a radiating geometric pattern. To the top center and left of this geometric section, two large vases filled with stylized, swirling green stems and multi-colored flowers—red, pink, and blue—are present, with smaller flowers scattered around. In the lower right, a third large vase with similarly curling green stems and flowers balances the composition. The border of the quilt is decorated with intertwining green vines creating an oval lattice, filled with various red, blue, and purple flowers, enclosing the quilt on three sides. Along the lower center, there is a row of red and green star motifs, while the bottom left corner displays another partially visible vase with similar stylized floral decoration. The entire composition repeats the use of red, green, teal, and pink hues, with green foliage and multi-colored blossoming flowers as major decorative elements.
title: Applique and Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
